@@U01724@@
“Chacun a son gout!” | cried, raising my glass. “Show me a girl to match my 格蕾琴! Show me a better sister!” We all clinked glasses at that. And the braggarts sat there like bumps on a log. But they scorn me now, sneer at me, call me names! I sit there ashamed, taking it all, and I| can’t call one of them a liar! Who's that coming? Two of them, slinking toward her door. If that’s the bastard, I'll kill him! Vl kill him!

@@U01725@@
(Enter 浮士德 and 梅菲斯特.)

@@U01727@@
I see the sanctuary lamp in the sacristy, its gleam shoots upwards, then, fainter and fainter, fades away, swallowed by darkness and gloom, the same gloom that has captured my heart.

@@U01729@@
And I'm like any old alley tomcat out on the prowl, up the fire escape, hugging close along the wall, always looking, primed for the pounce. And to be quite honest, I feel rather virtuous about it, I do. A touch of thievery, a soupcon of lechery. Every tingling limb looks forward to 瓦尔普吉斯 Night. The glory of it, two more days, that’s when you learn what it means to be alive!
translation:
@@U01724@@
“差存一个儿子痛风！” |举起酒杯喊道。 “给我看一个能配我格蕾琴的女孩！给我看一个更好的姐姐！”我们都碰杯了。吹牛者坐在那里，就像木头上的凹凸一样。但他们现在却蔑视我，嘲笑我，辱骂我！我羞愧地坐在那里，接受这一切，而我|不能说他们中的一个是骗子！那是谁来了？其中两个人，偷偷地朝她的门走去。如果是这个混蛋，我就杀了他！我要杀了他！

@@U01725@@
（浮士德和梅菲斯特上。）

@@U01727@@
我看到圣器收藏室里的圣所灯，它的光芒向上射出，然后，越来越微弱，渐渐消失，被黑暗和阴郁所吞噬，同样的阴郁俘获了我的心。

@@U01729@@
我就像一只在巷子里徘徊的老雄猫，爬上消防梯，沿着墙紧紧拥抱，总是在寻找，准备好猛扑。说实话，我对此感到相当有道德，我确实如此。一点偷窃的味道，一点淫荡的味道。每一个颤抖的肢体都期待着瓦尔普吉斯之夜。最光荣的是，再过两天，你就会明白活着意味着什么！
